department: School of Environmental Studies / Department of Chemistry

deadline.value: International Fall 2027 application deadline is May 1, 2027 (document submissions due June 1).

also.quote: International Application Deadlines | Fall | Application | Document Submissions | May 1 | June 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required (waived) for all concentrations in the Environmental Sciences Ph.D. program.
gre_general.quote: GRE is now waived for the Environmental Sciences Ph.D. program.

also.quote: NO LONGER REQUIRED - GRE scores of at least 300 (Quantitative + Verbal) and 3.5 (Analytical Writing) for students entering any concentration within the Environmental Sciences Ph.D. degree program.

toefl_min.value: International student documentation lists 4.0 on the new 2026 TOEFL scale (79 iBT prior scale) for Environmental Sciences Chemistry (Ph.D.); note the ENV-CHEM catalog program page still shows 3.5.

also.quote: international students must have a score of 3.5 or above on the TOEFL

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Chemistry.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Unlike other EVS concentrations, the Chemistry concentration requires a CV and cover letter instead of a pre-admission Graduate Advisor Acceptance Form.

funding.value: Competitive EVS Graduate Assistantships provide a $2,000/month ($24,000/year) stipend with full tuition and fee waiver (committee meets in March/April, decisions usually by April 15; full admission required first).
funding.quote: Stipend amount is $2,000/month or $24,000/year with a full tuition and fee waiver.

also.quote: The EVS PhD Graduate Review Committee meets once a year in March or April to make decisions on assistantships and continuations for current students.

entry_route.value: Requires a bachelor's or master's degree (ACS-certified chemistry B.S. or equivalent coursework) with minimum 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for admission to the doctoral program in Environmental Sciences must have: | a bachelor's or master's degree in science, mathematics, engineering, or environmental science;

notes: Chemistry concentration (ENV-CHEM) of the interdisciplinary Environmental Sciences Ph.D. in the School of Environmental Studies. EVS Graduate Review Committee meets in March/April for assistantships (decisions usually by April 15).
name: Environmental Sciences, Chemistry Concentration, Ph.D.
